first_embedding_certificate.block_identity: L_(a,0)=diag(L_a,R_a), R_a=-C L_a C for the pure path
first_embedding_certificate.parameter_domain: all real t, via coefficientwise polynomial identities
first_embedding_certificate.rank_equality_reason: C is invertible; R_a and L_a have identical rank
first_embedding_certificate.scope: The first embedding is checked directly; Theorem 10.1 supplies the general induction.

full_pair_space_model.missing: coverage and attachment certificates for arbitrary real first operands outside the certified path

model.induction_hypothesis: a_n(t) perpendicular to C_n; real and distinguished-unit coefficients vanish at every embedding
model.space: unit zero-product pairs over the zero-padded normalized certified path, t in [0,2]

cohomology_ring.justification: Geometric nullhomotopies and tree collapse give a wedge; chain ranks alone do not determine products.

topological_model.identification: homotopy equivalence to the listed wedge; no homeomorphism to the wedge is claimed

quotient_homeomorphism: constant S(W) x [0,2] glued to endpoint spheres S(K_0),S(K_1),S(K_2) along S(W)
quotient_justification: continuous bijection from compact quotient to the Hausdorff restricted incidence space

rank_attachment_certificate.arithmetic: SymPy polynomial identities over Q[t] and exact rational rank certificates
rank_attachment_certificate.constant_kernel_gram: 4I; division by 2 gives a constant orthonormal frame
rank_attachment_certificate.limiting_frames: The same constant orthonormal frame extends from each open interval to both endpoints.
rank_attachment_certificate.scope: This certificate classifies the selected polynomial path; it does not classify the full dimension-32 zero-divisor locus.
